chs.name: Sum of All Fears
chs.description: 负面魔法。 For 4...12 seconds, target foe moves, attacks, and casts spells 33% slower.
chs.concise: 负面魔法。 (4...12 seconds.) Target foe moves, attacks, and casts spells 33% slower.

cht.name: 恐懼共計
